remarks:
Well-maintained farm property in a prime location, just minutes from the Clarence Center Town Line. Perfect for a boarding or training facility, this property features 23 spacious horse stalls, a 7,200 sq ft indoor riding arena with a heated viewing room, and an expansive outdoor riding arena for complete horse training and equestrian activities.
The residential home on site has been beautifully upgraded to blend rustic charm with modern living. The interior boasts extensive updates, including a fully renovated kitchen with premium countertops and stainless steel appliances, beautifully modernized bathrooms with contemporary tile work, and stunning new flooring throughout the expansive living spaces. This beautifully maintained interior offers high-end comfort alongside elite business amenities.
The property previously generated strong rental income of up to $6,300/month. Behind the equestrian facilities lies a large parcel of land with excellent opportunities for future development, expansion, or agricultural use. Parcel boundaries were recently reconfigured, and an updated survey confirms the actual lot size is 10.73 acres. The adjacent properties at 13081 Main Rd and 13151 Main Rd are also currently available for sale.
A rare opportunity for equestrian enthusiasts, investors, or buyers seeking land with development potential!
